name: popsicle
headline: datum.net: Official Datum Website & Content Hub
short_description: Official Datum Inc. website built with Astro, featuring blog content, company handbook, and API documentation with Strapi-backed content management.
author: datum-cloud

sections.overview:
datum.net is the official website for Datum Inc., built with Astro and designed to manage multiple content types including blog articles, company handbook, changelog, and API documentation. The site uses Front Matter CMS and Strapi for flexible content authoring, allowing teams to publish and maintain marketing content, internal documentation, and developer resources. It supports both Docker and Kubernetes deployment environments, with production-grade tooling including end-to-end testing, markdown linting, and automated API documentation generation. The platform integrates third-party services and provides hot-reloading development workflows for rapid content iteration.
Publishing and managing company blog posts and marketing content
Maintaining internal handbooks and company documentation
Publishing API documentation with automated version updates
Managing changelog entries and product release notes
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/datum-cloud/datum.net`
sections.usage:
```
Create a detailed marketing plan for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include sections for target audience analysis, content strategy, social media tactics, and performance metrics. Ensure the plan aligns with [COMPANY]'s brand voice and values.
```
